LanguageData.CC_Group_Regroup: Over the next days the colony's groups will settle around what really binds their people: some who only fought side by side may drift apart, and new groups may form.
LanguageData.CC_Group_OutsideTip: Groups form around what binds some of the colony more than the rest: friends, the same work, the night hours, an ideoligion held hard, where they came from, their age. Someone at odds with people in a group, new to the colony, or simply their own stands outside every group, and feels it now and then.
